description.en:
The 10-piece pack is the largest size of TL Taufu Keras, Tung Lam’s traditional firm tofu (tau kwa), packed for kitchens that go through tofu quickly. Think mixed-rice stalls, mamak kitchens frying mee goreng to order, rojak and tauhu bakar sellers, school canteens and caterers – or a home cook preparing for a kenduri or reunion dinner.

Buying in a larger pack means fewer packs to open and less packaging to handle during a busy service. The blocks are uniform and firm, so they can be cut into consistent cubes or slices for portioning, and they stay intact when deep-fried in batches.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and rotate stock so older packs are used first. For regular wholesale supply, contact the Tung Lam sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

description.en:
The 500g bag of Tofu Goreng Keping holds nearly twice as much as the 270g pack, giving you a good supply of Tung Lam’s square tofu puffs in one go. It suits yong tau foo stalls and small eateries, larger families, and home cooks who like to prepare stuffed tau pok in batches for the freezer or for festive gatherings.

Square puffs have broad, flat sides that open easily into pockets. Fill them with fish paste and pan-fry or steam, or cut them into triangles for a braise. Their even shape also lines up neatly in a tray, which helps when you are preparing dozens of pieces at once.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and reseal the bag after opening. For trade orders or regular deliveries, please reach our sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Pek 500g Tofu Goreng Keping mengandungi hampir dua kali ganda berbanding pek 270g, jadi anda mendapat bekalan tauhu pok segi empat Tung Lam yang mencukupi sekali gus. Ia sesuai untuk gerai yong tau foo dan kedai makan kecil, keluarga besar, serta tukang masak yang suka menyediakan tauhu pok sumbat secara banyak untuk disimpan atau untuk majlis perayaan.

Tauhu pok segi empat mempunyai sisi yang lebar dan leper, mudah dibuka menjadi poket. Isi dengan isi ikan, kemudian goreng atau kukus, atau potong segi tiga untuk dimasak berkuah. Bentuknya yang seragam juga mudah disusun dalam dulang apabila menyediakan berpuluh-puluh keping.

Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan tutup rapat selepas dibuka. Untuk pesanan perniagaan atau penghantaran berkala, sila hubungi pasukan jualan kami melalui WhatsApp atau e-mel. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
TL Cincau Asli is Tung Lam’s original grass jelly in a 2kg block. Cincau – also called grass jelly or chin chow – is the dark, wobbly jelly that turns up in cold drinks and desserts across Malaysia, and this large format is made for businesses that serve it by the glass or bowl all day.

A 2kg block is easy to cut to whatever size your menu needs: small cubes for ais kacang and bubble tea, long strips for air cincau, or larger chunks for dessert bowls. Drink stalls, kopitiams, mamak restaurants, dessert shops and caterers can portion from one block rather than opening many small packs, which keeps preparation quick during peak hours.

For best results, cut with a wet knife and keep the jelly covered after opening. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. For regular supply, contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
TL Cincau Asli ialah cincau asli Tung Lam dalam blok 2kg. Cincau – juga dikenali sebagai grass jelly atau chin chow – ialah jeli hitam yang lembut dan bergoyang, sering ada dalam minuman sejuk dan pencuci mulut di seluruh Malaysia. Format besar ini dibuat untuk perniagaan yang menghidangkannya segelas demi segelas sepanjang hari.

Blok 2kg mudah dipotong mengikut saiz yang diperlukan menu anda: kiub kecil untuk ais kacang dan teh buih, jalur panjang untuk air cincau, atau ketulan besar untuk mangkuk pencuci mulut. Gerai minuman, kopitiam, restoran mamak, kedai pencuci mulut dan katering boleh memotong daripada satu blok dan bukannya membuka banyak pek kecil, jadi kerja penyediaan lebih cepat pada waktu puncak.

Untuk hasil terbaik, potong dengan pisau basah dan tutup cincau selepas dibuka. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Untuk bekalan tetap, hubungi pasukan jualan kami melalui WhatsApp atau e-mel. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
When four blocks are not quite enough, the 6-piece pack of TL Taufu Keras gives you more of Tung Lam’s traditional firm tofu in one vacuum-sealed pack. It is a practical choice for larger families, households that cook tofu several times a week, or anyone preparing food for a small gathering.

Because tau kwa is dense and holds together well, it is ideal for batch cooking. Fry a tray of tofu cubes in one go and use them across different dishes, or marinate thick slices overnight for grilling the next day. It also works well in dishes that are reheated, such as curries and braises, where softer tofu would break down.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and cook soon after opening. Produced from soybeans by Tung Lam Food Industries in Menglembu, Perak – a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Apabila empat keping tidak mencukupi, pek 6 keping TL Taufu Keras memberikan lebih banyak tauhu keras tradisional Tung Lam dalam satu bungkusan vakum. Ia pilihan praktikal untuk keluarga besar, isi rumah yang memasak tauhu beberapa kali seminggu, atau sesiapa yang menyediakan makanan untuk majlis kecil.

Oleh sebab tau kwa padat dan tidak mudah hancur, ia sangat sesuai untuk masakan secara pukal. Goreng sedulang tauhu kiub sekali gus untuk pelbagai hidangan, atau perap hirisan tebal semalaman untuk dibakar keesokan harinya. Ia juga sesuai untuk masakan yang dipanaskan semula seperti kari dan masak kicap.

Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan masak segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya oleh Tung Lam Food Industries di Menglembu, Perak – pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
Tofu Goreng Keping is the square cut of Tung Lam’s tofu puffs – the pack reads Keping (Square) under the Taufu Goreng – Tofu Puff name. Compared with the round puffs, these are broader, flatter pieces with more surface area, which changes how you can use them.

The square shape is ideal for stuffing: slit one side and you have a neat pocket for fish paste, minced chicken or shredded vegetables. Square puffs can also be sliced into strips and tossed through fried noodles, or simmered whole in a braise where they lie flat in the pot and absorb the sauce evenly.

The 270g bag is a home-kitchen size, enough for a family meal or a couple of dishes through the week. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Bentuk segi empat paling sesuai untuk disumbat: belah satu sisi dan anda mendapat poket yang kemas untuk diisi isi ikan, ayam cincang atau sayur hiris. Ia juga boleh dihiris memanjang untuk digaul bersama mi goreng, atau direneh keseluruhan dalam masakan berkuah supaya menyerap rasa dengan sekata.

Pek 270g ialah saiz dapur rumah, cukup untuk hidangan keluarga atau beberapa masakan dalam seminggu. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
Sakura Egg Tofu comes from the Sakura brand in the Tung Lam portfolio, recognisable by its cherry-blossom pack, the 鸡蛋豆腐 / 玉子とうふ name and the slogan because you love life (珍爱生命的选择). At 150g, it is the largest single egg tofu tube in the range.

The Japanese-style presentation hints at how it shines best: in gentle, clean-tasting dishes. Slice into thick rounds and steam with a light soy dressing, warm it in dashi-style broth, or coat in potato starch and shallow-fry for an agedashi-style plate. The bigger tube gives you neater, more generous slices for plating.

To remove it cleanly, cut the tube across the middle and push each half out gently. Contains egg – please refer to the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Produced in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

Hiris tebal dan kukus dengan kuah kicap ringan, panaskan dalam sup gaya dashi, atau salut dengan tepung ubi kentang dan goreng cetek ala agedashi. description.en:
TL Egg Tofu 130g comes in Tung Lam’s vacuum-packed tube with the hen illustration and the Chinese name 蛋豆腐. It offers the same smooth, golden egg tofu as the rest of the TL range, in a slightly larger 130g size.

Those extra grams make a difference when egg tofu is the main protein on the table – a few more slices for a family of four, or thicker cuts that stand up better to braising. Try slicing it into thick rounds, steaming them with a little soy sauce and fried shallots, or braising them gently with prawns and vegetables in a light gravy.

As with all egg tofu, cut the tube in half and ease each piece out gently, and avoid stirring too hard once it is in the pan. Contains egg – see the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

Beberapa gram tambahan itu bermakna apabila tauhu telur menjadi lauk utama – lebih banyak hirisan untuk keluarga berempat, atau potongan lebih tebal yang lebih tahan apabila dimasak berkuah. Cuba hiris tebal dan kukus bersama sedikit kicap serta bawang goreng, atau masak perlahan bersama udang dan sayur dalam kuah pekat.

Seperti tauhu telur lain, potong tiub di tengah dan keluarkan perlahan-lahan, serta jangan kacau terlalu kuat di dalam kuali. Mengandungi telur – lihat bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. description.en:
TL Egg Tofu 120g is the everyday egg tofu from Tung Lam – the orange-labelled tube marked Taufu Telur / Egg Tofu that many Malaysian families keep in the fridge for a quick lauk. Egg tofu is made with egg, giving it a smoother, richer, more custard-like bite than plain tofu and a pale golden colour.

One 120g tube is a handy amount for a single dish to share at dinner. To get it out neatly, cut the tube in half with a sharp knife and gently squeeze each half out, then slice into rounds. Dust the slices lightly with cornflour and pan-fry until golden, then finish with a sauce – minced chicken, mushrooms in oyster sauce, or a simple soy and spring onion dressing. Handle gently, as the texture is delicate.

Contains egg; please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen details. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Tauhu telur dibuat dengan telur, menjadikannya lebih licin, lemak dan lembut seperti kastard berbanding tauhu biasa, dengan warna kuning pucat.

Satu tiub 120g cukup untuk satu hidangan dikongsi semasa makan malam. Untuk mengeluarkannya dengan kemas, potong tiub di tengah dengan pisau tajam dan picit perlahan-lahan setiap bahagian, kemudian hiris bulat. Salut hirisan dengan sedikit tepung jagung dan goreng hingga keemasan, lalu siram dengan kuah – ayam cincang, cendawan sos tiram atau kicap dengan daun bawang. Kendalikan dengan cermat kerana teksturnya lembut.

Mengandungi telur; sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

Egg tofu is delicate: cut each tube in half, ease it out gently, and slice into rounds before cooking. Contains egg – check the pack for full ingredient and allergen details. description.en:
Tofu Goreng Panjang is the long cut in Tung Lam’s tofu puff family, labelled Panjang (Long) on the pack. These rectangular tau pok are longer than the round and square versions, which makes them handy in a few specific ways.

Their length is perfect for a Malay-style tauhu sumbat: slit lengthways and pack with shredded cucumber, sengkuang and bean sprouts, then drizzle with peanut-chilli sauce. They also thread easily onto skewers for lok-lok or a home steamboat, and can be cut crossways into bite-size pieces for curry noodles or soups. Simmered in gravy, the spongy inside soaks up flavour just like the other cuts.

The 270g bag is a convenient home size. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Produced from soybeans by Tung Lam Food Industries in Menglembu, Perak – a Halal-certified manufacturer also holding HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Tofu Goreng Panjang ialah potongan panjang dalam keluarga tauhu pok Tung Lam, berlabel Panjang (Long) pada bungkusan. Tauhu pok segi empat tepat ini lebih panjang berbanding versi bulat dan segi empat, jadi ia sangat praktikal untuk beberapa kegunaan.

Panjangnya amat sesuai untuk tauhu sumbat gaya Melayu: belah memanjang dan isi dengan timun, sengkuang dan taugeh, kemudian siram dengan kuah kacang pedas. Ia juga mudah dicucuk untuk lok-lok atau stimbot di rumah, dan boleh dipotong kecil untuk mi kari atau sup. Apabila direneh dalam kuah, isinya yang berongga menyerap rasa sama seperti potongan lain.

Pek 270g ialah saiz rumah yang mudah. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya oleh Tung Lam Food Industries di Menglembu, Perak – pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
The 4-piece pack is the everyday size of TL Taufu Keras, Tung Lam’s traditional firm tofu (tau kwa). Four dense, pressed blocks give a typical Malaysian household enough for a family dinner, or two lighter meals across the week – one night grilled as tauhu bakar, another cubed into a curry or sayur lodeh.

Firm tofu is the most forgiving tofu to cook with. It can be pan-fried until golden without breaking, cut into thick slices for stuffing, or simmered in gravies where it soaks up flavour. Pat each block dry before frying for a crisper surface.

The blocks come vacuum-packed, which keeps them neat in the fridge until needed. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and once opened, cook within a short time. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak, by a Halal-certified producer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Pek 4 keping ialah saiz harian bagi TL Taufu Keras, tauhu keras tradisional (tau kwa) keluaran Tung Lam. Empat keping tauhu yang padat cukup untuk makan malam sekeluarga, atau dua hidangan ringan dalam seminggu – satu malam dibakar sebagai tauhu bakar, satu lagi dipotong kiub untuk kari atau sayur lodeh.

Tauhu keras paling mudah dimasak. Ia boleh digoreng hingga keemasan tanpa pecah, dihiris tebal untuk disumbat, atau direneh dalam kuah supaya menyerap rasa. Keringkan tauhu dengan tuala dapur sebelum menggoreng supaya permukaannya lebih rangup.

Tauhu dibungkus secara vakum supaya kemas di dalam peti sejuk. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan masak segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:

It is pressed dense and sturdy, so it keeps its shape when you cube it for a stir-fry, slice it for the grill or slit it open for stuffing. If a recipe calls for tofu that will not crumble in the wok, this is the one.

The 2-piece pack is the smallest size in the range. It suits people living alone, couples, or anyone who only needs a little tofu for tonight’s dinner and would rather not have half a pack waiting in the fridge. Each pack is vacuum-sealed, so it is easy to store until you are ready to cook; keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and use promptly once opened.

Ia sesuai untuk mereka yang tinggal seorang, pasangan, atau sesiapa yang hanya perlukan sedikit tauhu untuk makan malam tanpa lebihan di dalam peti sejuk. description.en:
TauFu TeoChew is a Teochew-style tau kwa – printed on the pack as Soybean 潮州豆干, Teoh Chew Tau Kwa. Teochew cooking is known for simple, clean flavours, and tau kwa is one of its staples: braised gently in soy sauce and spices, or pan-fried and served with a sharp garlic-vinegar dip.

This 350g pack is a firm soybean curd that slices cleanly, making it well suited to dishes where the tofu is the star rather than a filler. Cut it into thick slabs for braising so it absorbs the sauce, or into thin slices for a quick stir-fry with vegetables. It also pairs naturally with braised duck and boiled eggs on a Teochew-style platter.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and cook soon after opening. Produced in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

Pek 350g ini ialah tauhu soya padat yang mudah dihiris kemas, sesuai untuk hidangan yang menonjolkan tauhu itu sendiri. Potong kepingan tebal untuk dimasak kicap supaya menyerap kuah, atau hiris nipis untuk ditumis bersama sayur. Ia juga sepadan dengan itik masak kicap dan telur rebus dalam hidangan gaya Teochew.

Goreng satu untuk lauk hari biasa, masukkan satu lagi ke dalam sup, dan simpan yang terakhir untuk stimbot hujung minggu. Apabila menerima tetamu, dua atau tiga tiub yang dihiris dan disusun di atas pinggan bersama kuah menjadi hidangan kongsi yang mudah.

Potong setiap tiub di tengah dan keluarkan perlahan-lahan kerana tauhu telur lembut. Mengandungi telur – sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. description.en:
TL Silken Tofu comes in a 300g box labelled Silken Tofu / Taufu Lembut with the Chinese name 嫩滑豆腐. Silken tofu is the softest style of tofu – smooth, tender and almost custard-like – and the box keeps the block whole and neat until you are ready to use it.

Because it is so soft, silken tofu is best in gentle dishes. Turn the block out onto a plate, top with minced chicken and soy sauce and steam it; slide cubes into a light soup at the end of cooking; or serve it cold with soy sauce, spring onion and fried shallots. It can also be blended into smooth sauces and desserts.

To unmould, peel back the film, pour off the water, then turn the box over onto a plate and let the tofu slide out. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and use soon after opening. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
TL Taufu Lembut didatangkan dalam kotak 300g berlabel Silken Tofu / Taufu Lembut dengan nama Cina 嫩滑豆腐. Tauhu lembut ialah jenis tauhu paling halus – licin, lembut dan hampir seperti kastard – dan kotaknya memastikan tauhu kekal sempurna sehingga digunakan.

Oleh sebab ia sangat lembut, tauhu ini paling sesuai untuk masakan yang ringkas. Terbalikkan ke atas pinggan, letak ayam cincang dan kicap, kemudian kukus; masukkan kiub tauhu ke dalam sup ringan pada akhir masakan; atau hidang sejuk dengan kicap, daun bawang dan bawang goreng. Ia juga boleh dikisar untuk sos dan pencuci mulut yang licin.

Untuk mengeluarkannya, kupas filem penutup, tuang keluar air, kemudian terbalikkan kotak ke atas pinggan dan biarkan tauhu tergelincir keluar. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan gunakan segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.
description.zh:
TL 嫩滑豆腐为300克盒装，包装标有 Silken Tofu / Taufu Lembut 及「嫩滑豆腐」。嫩豆腐是最柔软的一种豆腐，细滑、软嫩，几乎像布丁，盒装能让整块豆腐在使用前保持完整。

正因为柔软，嫩豆腐最适合温和的做法：倒扣在盘上，铺上鸡肉碎、淋酱油清蒸；在清汤快煮好时滑入豆腐丁；或直接冷食，配酱油、葱花和葱油酥。也可以打成顺滑的酱汁或甜品。

取出方法：撕开封膜、倒掉盒内的水，再把盒子倒扣在盘上，让豆腐自然滑出。请按包装标示冷藏或冷冻保存，开封后尽快食用。由霹雳州万里望持有清真、HACCP、GMP 及 MeSTI 认证的东临食品以黄豆制作。

description.en:

The 1kg vacuum pack is a sharing size, suited to families, open houses, office gatherings and small parties. Cut it into cubes and serve over shaved ice, spoon it into glasses of cold soy milk, or add it to a fruit cocktail or longan dessert. Because no extra syrup is needed, it is one of the easiest desserts to put together for a crowd. For a single serving, the 260g tube is a handier choice.

Cut with a wet knife for neat cubes and keep any leftovers covered. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

Pek vakum 1kg ialah saiz untuk dikongsi, sesuai untuk keluarga, rumah terbuka, majlis pejabat dan parti kecil. Potong kiub dan hidang di atas ais serut, masukkan ke dalam gelas susu soya sejuk, atau tambah ke dalam koktel buah atau pencuci mulut laici. Tidak perlu sirap tambahan, jadi ia antara pencuci mulut paling mudah disediakan untuk ramai orang. Untuk satu hidangan, tiub 260g lebih sesuai.

Potong dengan pisau basah untuk kiub yang kemas dan tutup bakinya. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

The slim vacuum-packed tube is sized for one or two people. Keep a few in the fridge for hot afternoons, slice one into a glass of cold soy milk for a home-made soya cincau, or cube it over ice with a splash of evaporated milk. It is also an easy after-school snack or a light dessert after a spicy meal.

To serve neatly, snip open one end, slide the jelly onto a board and cut with a wet knife. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. For family gatherings, the 1kg pack offers more to share. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

description.en:
AD Fish Ball comes in the green AD Bebola Ikan pack, a 450g bag of plain white fish balls from the AD brand in the Tung Lam portfolio. It is a family-size retail pack that you will find in supermarkets and wet markets, sized for a full steamboat dinner or several bowls of noodle soup.

White fish balls are the most versatile item in a steamboat spread. Drop them into simmering broth and cook until they are heated through and float; slice them in half for fried noodles; or thread onto skewers with tofu puffs for a home lok-lok night. They are also a quick way to add protein to a bowl of clear mee hoon or kuey teow soup.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and cook thoroughly before serving. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Bebola ikan putih ialah bahan paling serba boleh dalam hidangan stimbot. Masukkan ke dalam sup yang mendidih dan masak sehingga panas sepenuhnya dan terapung; belah dua untuk mi goreng; atau cucuk bersama tauhu pok untuk malam lok-lok di rumah. Ia juga cara mudah menambah protein ke dalam semangkuk mihun atau kuey teow sup.

A 450g pack gives a household plenty to work with. Slice a strip or two into char kuey teow or fried mee hoon, add slices to curry mee or kuey teow soup, or cut into chunks for the steamboat. Fish cake can also be pan-fried on its own until the edges crisp and served with chilli sauce as a snack.

description.en:
Cili Brand Fish Cake is the Kek Ikan (鱼饼) from the Cili label in the Tung Lam portfolio – look for the cheerful chilli mascot on the red-and-white pack. At 280g, it is a compact pack of golden fish cake strips, ideal for smaller households or when you only need fish cake for a dish or two.

The smaller size is handy for everyday cooking: slice a strip into a plate of fried noodles tonight and use the rest in a soup later in the week. Thin diagonal slices are the classic choice for char kuey teow and curry mee, while thicker chunks work well in a steamboat or stir-fried with vegetables and sambal.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen details. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and heat through before eating. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Kek Ikan Jenama Cili ialah kek ikan (鱼饼) daripada label Cili dalam portfolio Tung Lam – cari maskot cili yang ceria pada bungkusan merah dan putih. Dengan berat 280g, ia pek padat berisi jalur kek ikan keemasan, sesuai untuk isi rumah kecil atau apabila anda hanya perlukan kek ikan untuk satu dua hidangan.

Saiz kecil ini praktikal untuk masakan harian: hiris satu jalur ke dalam mi goreng malam ini dan gunakan bakinya dalam sup pada hari lain. Hirisan nipis serong ialah pilihan klasik untuk char kuey teow dan kari mi, manakala ketulan tebal sesuai untuk stimbot atau ditumis bersama sayur dan sambal.

Mengandungi ikan – sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan, dan panaskan sepenuhnya sebelum dimakan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.
description.zh:

short.en: Sakura’s Japanese-style silken tofu (kinugoshi) in a 300g box – delicate and smooth for hiyayakko, miso soup and steamed dishes.

description.en:
Sakura Silken Tofu is the boxed silken tofu from Sakura, the brand in the Tung Lam portfolio that carries the slogan because you love life (珍爱生命的选择). The pack is printed with the Japanese name 絹こし豆腐 (kinugoshi tofu) and the Chinese 嫩滑豆腐, pointing to its smooth, fine-textured style.

Kinugoshi-style tofu is at its best in simple Japanese and Chinese dishes where texture matters. Serve it chilled as hiyayakko with grated ginger, spring onion and soy sauce; cut it into small cubes for miso soup; or steam the whole block and finish with hot oil, soy and coriander.

Peel back the film, drain off the water and turn the block out gently onto a plate. Use a flat spatula or wide spoon to move it, as it breaks easily. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and use promptly after opening. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Sakura Taufu Lembut ialah tauhu lembut berkotak daripada Sakura, jenama dalam portfolio Tung Lam yang membawa slogan because you love life (珍爱生命的选择). Bungkusannya tertera nama Jepun 絹こし豆腐 (tauhu kinugoshi) dan nama Cina 嫩滑豆腐, menunjukkan teksturnya yang licin dan halus.

Tauhu gaya kinugoshi paling sedap dalam masakan Jepun dan Cina yang ringkas, di mana teksturnya menjadi tumpuan. Hidang sejuk sebagai hiyayakko dengan halia parut, daun bawang dan kicap; potong kiub kecil untuk sup miso; atau kukus keseluruhan blok dan siram dengan minyak panas, kicap dan daun ketumbar.

Kupas filem penutup, tos air dan terbalikkan tauhu perlahan-lahan ke atas pinggan. Gunakan sudip leper atau sudu lebar untuk mengalihkannya kerana ia mudah pecah. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan gunakan segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.
description.zh:
Sakura 嫩滑豆腐是东临旗下 Sakura 品牌的盒装嫩豆腐，品牌标语为「because you love life · 珍爱生命的选择」。包装印有日文「絹こし豆腐」（绢豆腐）及中文「嫩滑豆腐」，说明它细腻柔滑的风格。

绢豆腐最适合讲究口感的日式与中式简单料理：冷食做成日式冷豆腐，配姜蓉、葱花和酱油；切小丁煮味噌汤；或整块清蒸后淋热油、酱油，撒上芫荽。

撕开封膜、沥去盒内水分，再轻轻把豆腐倒扣在盘上。移动时请用平铲或大汤匙，以免弄碎。请按包装标示冷藏或冷冻保存，开封后尽快食用。由霹雳州万里望的东临食品工业以黄豆制作，公司持有清真、HACCP、GMP 及 MeSTI 认证。

description.en:
This 250g Silken Tofu Tube is Tung Lam’s traditional silken tofu, sold under the TL label with the Chinese name 山水嫩豆腐 and the words Traditional Silken Tofu on the pack. Tube tofu has the same soft, smooth texture as boxed silken tofu, but its round shape makes it especially easy to portion.

Simply cut the tube into thick rounds and push the slices out – no turning out a block onto a plate. Neat round slices look great in clear soups, steamboat, or arranged on a plate for steaming with minced chicken, mushrooms or a soy and garlic topping. Because the tube is sealed, it is also a tidy option to keep in the fridge.

Silken tofu is fragile, so add it towards the end of cooking and stir gently. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and use soon after opening. Made from soybeans in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Taufu Lembut Tiub 250g ini ialah tauhu lembut tradisional Tung Lam, dijual di bawah label TL dengan nama Cina 山水嫩豆腐 serta perkataan Traditional Silken Tofu pada bungkusan. Tauhu tiub mempunyai tekstur licin dan lembut seperti tauhu berkotak, tetapi bentuknya yang bulat memudahkan pembahagian.

Potong sahaja tiub menjadi hirisan bulat yang tebal dan tolak keluar – tidak perlu menterbalikkan blok tauhu. Hirisan bulat yang kemas cantik dalam sup jernih, stimbot, atau disusun di atas pinggan untuk dikukus bersama ayam cincang, cendawan atau kicap bawang putih. Tiub yang dimeterai juga kemas untuk disimpan di dalam peti sejuk.

Tauhu lembut mudah pecah, jadi masukkan menjelang akhir masakan dan kacau perlahan. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan gunakan segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.
description.zh:

只需把豆腐筒切成厚圆片再推出即可，不必整块倒扣。整齐的圆片放进清汤、火锅里都很好看，也可以排在盘上，铺上鸡肉碎、香菇或蒜蓉酱油清蒸。密封筒装放在冰箱里也干净整齐。

description.en:
Cili Brand Fried Fish Ball is labelled Bebola Ikan Goreng Kecil – small fried fish balls, 小炸鱼丸 in Chinese – and comes in a 160g pack from the Cili label in the Tung Lam portfolio. The balls are already fried golden, giving them a slightly firmer skin and a savoury, toasty flavour that plain white fish balls do not have.

Their small size makes them easy to eat in one bite, which is why fried fish balls are a favourite for snacks and street-style dishes. Simmer them in curry sauce for Hong Kong-style curry fish balls, thread them onto skewers for lok-lok, or add a handful to a bowl of laksa. Reheated in an air fryer, they make a simple snack with chilli sauce.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen details. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and heat through before eating. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Saiznya yang kecil mudah dimakan sesuap, sebab itulah bebola ikan goreng menjadi kegemaran untuk snek dan hidangan gaya jalanan. Reneh dalam kuah kari untuk bebola ikan kari gaya Hong Kong, cucuk untuk lok-lok, atau tambah segenggam ke dalam semangkuk laksa. Panaskan sebentar dalam penggoreng udara atau kuali untuk snek ringkas bersama sos cili.

Pek 160g ialah saiz kecil untuk satu hidangan. Mengandungi ikan – sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan panaskan sepenuhnya sebelum dimakan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

The 160g size is made for small households and quick meals. Simmer a handful in chicken or anchovy stock with some greens for a simple fish ball soup, add them to a bowl of kuey teow or mee hoon, or keep a pack in the freezer to top up a steamboat when the first round runs out. Cook them gently until heated through – they will rise to the surface.

TL Cincau Tawar is Tung Lam’s plain grass jelly, labelled Cincau Tanpa Gula / 无糖凉粉 and Dessert No Added Sugar. Tawar means plain: this cincau leaves the sweetness entirely up to you, which makes it the more flexible choice in the cincau range.

With no sugar added, you can sweeten it exactly as you like – drizzle with gula melaka syrup and coconut milk, stir in a little honey, or pair it with already-sweet ingredients such as soy milk, fruit or ice cream. It also suits people who prefer a less sweet dessert or who want to control the sugar in drinks they make at home, and cafés that build their own grass jelly drinks.

The 480g pack is a family size. Cut with a wet knife into cubes or strips and keep any leftovers covered. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
TL Cincau Tawar ialah cincau biasa keluaran Tung Lam, berlabel Cincau Tanpa Gula / 无糖凉粉 dan Dessert No Added Sugar. Tawar bermaksud tanpa rasa manis: cincau ini membiarkan tahap kemanisan sepenuhnya kepada anda, menjadikannya pilihan paling fleksibel dalam rangkaian cincau.

Tanpa gula tambahan, anda boleh memaniskannya mengikut citarasa – siram dengan sirap gula melaka dan santan, kacau dengan sedikit madu, atau padankan dengan bahan yang sudah manis seperti susu soya, buah-buahan atau aiskrim. Ia juga sesuai untuk mereka yang lebih gemar pencuci mulut kurang manis atau mahu mengawal gula dalam minuman buatan sendiri, serta kafe yang menghasilkan minuman cincau mereka sendiri.

Pek 480g ialah saiz keluarga. Potong kiub atau jalur dengan pisau basah dan tutup bakinya. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
Tofu Goreng Bulat in a 1kg bag is Tung Lam’s food-service pack of round tofu puffs. It is meant for kitchens where tau pok goes into almost every bowl – curry mee and laksa stalls, yong tau foo counters, economy rice stalls, steamboat restaurants and caterers.

Because tofu puffs are so light, a 1kg bag holds a large quantity of pieces, cutting down on reorders and packaging waste. The round, even cut makes portioning simple: count the pieces per bowl and costs stay predictable. They can be added straight to bubbling gravy, or slit and filled with fish paste for yong tau foo.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, reseal opened bags well and use stock in rotation. To set up regular supply for your stall or restaurant, contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email. Produced in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Tofu Goreng Bulat dalam pek 1kg ialah pek perkhidmatan makanan Tung Lam untuk tauhu pok bulat. Ia direka untuk dapur yang menggunakan tauhu pok dalam hampir setiap mangkuk – gerai kari mi dan laksa, kaunter yong tau foo, gerai nasi campur, restoran stimbot dan katering.

Oleh sebab tauhu pok sangat ringan, pek 1kg mengandungi jumlah biji yang banyak, jadi kurang kerap perlu membuat pesanan semula dan kurang sisa bungkusan. Potongan bulat yang seragam memudahkan pembahagian: kira bilangan biji semangkuk dan kos lebih terkawal. Ia boleh dimasukkan terus ke dalam kuah yang mendidih, atau dibelah dan diisi dengan isi ikan untuk yong tau foo.

Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan, tutup rapat pek yang telah dibuka dan gunakan stok mengikut giliran. Untuk bekalan tetap bagi gerai atau restoran anda, hubungi pasukan jualan kami melalui WhatsApp atau e-mel. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
The 270g bag of Tofu Goreng Bulat is the household favourite in Tung Lam’s tofu puff range. Inside are golden, round-cut tau pok – deep-fried pieces of soybean curd that turn puffy and spongy, ready to drink up whatever broth or gravy you cook them in.

A 270g bag is a comfortable size for regular home cooking. Use a handful in a weeknight curry, drop a few into a steamboat, and still have some left for a braise later in the week. Tofu puffs are light, so the bag holds a generous number of pieces.

For the best texture, add tofu puffs towards the end of cooking so they absorb flavour while keeping some bite; for a softer, juicier result, simmer them a little longer. You can also briefly blanch them in hot water to refresh before use. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Pek 270g Tofu Goreng Bulat ialah pilihan kegemaran isi rumah dalam rangkaian tauhu pok Tung Lam. Di dalamnya ialah tauhu pok bulat keemasan – tauhu soya yang digoreng hingga mengembang dan berongga, sedia menyerap sup atau kuah yang dimasak bersamanya.

Saiz 270g sesuai untuk masakan harian di rumah. Gunakan segenggam untuk kari pada hari biasa, masukkan beberapa biji ke dalam stimbot, dan masih ada baki untuk lauk berkuah pada hujung minggu. Tauhu pok ringan, jadi satu pek mengandungi banyak biji.

Untuk tekstur terbaik, masukkan tauhu pok menjelang akhir masakan supaya ia menyerap rasa tetapi masih kenyal; untuk hasil lebih lembut dan berjus, reneh lebih lama. Anda juga boleh celur sebentar dalam air panas sebelum digunakan. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan di Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
Tofu Goreng Bulat are Tung Lam’s round-cut tofu puffs, the golden, airy tau pok that Malaysians love in curry mee and laksa. The pack carries the Chinese name 油扬豆腐卜 alongside Taufu Goreng – Tofu Puff. Deep-fried until puffed, each piece has a thin skin and a spongy inside that soaks up gravy like nothing else.

This 10-piece pack is counted rather than weighed, which makes it easy to plan: two or three puffs per bowl means one pack comfortably covers a family pot of curry noodles. It is also a convenient size for trying tofu puffs in a new recipe without committing to a large bag.

To use, add the puffs straight into simmering soup or gravy for the last few minutes, or halve them and fill with fish paste. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Bungkusannya tertera Taufu Goreng – Tofu Puff serta nama Cina 油扬豆腐卜. Setiap biji digoreng sehingga mengembang, dengan kulit nipis dan isi berongga yang menyerap kuah dengan baik.

Pek 10 biji ini dikira mengikut bilangan, jadi mudah dirancang: dua atau tiga biji semangkuk bermakna satu pek cukup untuk satu periuk kari mi sekeluarga. Saiz ini juga sesuai jika anda mahu mencuba tauhu pok dalam resipi baharu tanpa membeli pek besar.

Masukkan terus ke dalam sup atau kuah yang sedang mendidih beberapa minit sebelum siap, atau belah dua dan isi dengan isi ikan. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
Sakura Silken Tofu Tube is the tube version of Sakura’s Japanese-style silken tofu. The pack reads Silken Tofu / Taufu Lembut alongside 絹こし豆腐 and the brand slogan because you love life (珍爱生命的选择). Sakura is one of the brands in the Tung Lam portfolio, made in the company’s Menglembu, Perak facility.

If you like the smooth kinugoshi texture of the Sakura box but want something easier to portion, the 250g tube is the answer. Slice straight through the tube into even rounds – they hold their shape well enough for a quick simmer in miso or clear soup, a few minutes in the steamboat, or steaming with a light soy dressing.

Handle the slices gently and add them late in cooking so they stay intact. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and use promptly once opened. Made from soybeans by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:

Sakura ialah salah satu jenama dalam portfolio Tung Lam, dihasilkan di kilang syarikat di Menglembu, Perak.

Jika anda suka tekstur kinugoshi yang licin pada kotak Sakura tetapi mahu sesuatu yang lebih mudah dibahagi, tiub 250g ialah jawapannya. Hiris terus menembusi tiub menjadi kepingan bulat yang sekata – ia cukup kukuh untuk direneh sebentar dalam sup miso atau sup jernih, dimasak beberapa minit dalam stimbot, atau dikukus dengan kicap ringan.

Kendalikan hirisan dengan cermat dan masukkan lewat dalam masakan supaya kekal elok. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan dan gunakan segera selepas dibuka. Diperbuat daripada kacang soya oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

description.en:
TL Lingo Kek Ikan is a 1kg food-service bag from Tung Lam, labelled Kek Ikan (Lingo). Inside are flat, rounded golden fish cakes – a different shape from the long strips in the Kek Ikan Panjang pack – packed loose in a clear bag for easy portioning.

The Lingo shape suits kitchens that serve fish cake as a piece rather than as thin slices. Use them whole or halved in yong tau foo selections, cut them into wedges for steamboat sets, or slice across for noodles. The 1kg format is designed for hawker stalls, mixed-rice and noodle shops, caterers and steamboat restaurants that need a steady supply.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, reseal after opening and heat thoroughly before serving. For trade supply, contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

TL Kek Ikan (Lingo) ialah pek perkhidmatan makanan 1kg daripada Tung Lam, berlabel Kek Ikan (Lingo). Di dalamnya terdapat kek ikan keemasan yang leper dan bulat – bentuk yang berbeza daripada jalur panjang dalam pek Kek Ikan Panjang – dibungkus longgar dalam beg lutsinar supaya mudah dibahagikan.

Bentuk Lingo sesuai untuk dapur yang menghidangkan kek ikan sebagai seketul, bukan hirisan nipis. Gunakan keseluruhan atau dibelah dua dalam pilihan yong tau foo, potong baji untuk set stimbot, atau hiris melintang untuk mi. Format 1kg ini direka untuk gerai penjaja, kedai nasi campur dan mi, katering serta restoran stimbot yang memerlukan bekalan tetap.

Mengandungi ikan – sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan, tutup rapat selepas dibuka dan panaskan sepenuhnya sebelum dihidang. Untuk bekalan perniagaan, hubungi pasukan jualan kami melalui WhatsApp atau e-mel. Dikeluarkan di Menglembu, Perak oleh pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.

This is the fish cake for kitchens that slice to order. Char kuey teow and fried noodle stalls, curry mee and laksa sellers, kuey teow soup shops and economy rice stalls all rely on a steady supply of fish cake slices, and the long shape gives consistent pieces with little waste. The 1kg bag reduces how often you need to reorder.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen details. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, keep the bag sealed between uses, and heat through before serving. To arrange regular supply, contact the Tung Lam sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made in Menglembu, Perak by a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

TL Bebola Goreng Besar is Tung Lam’s large fried fish ball, packed in a 1kg food-service bag labelled Bebola Ikan Goreng Besar (BGB). Each ball is fried until golden, giving a savoury skin and a satisfying, substantial bite.

The larger size makes each piece feel generous on the plate, which is why big fried fish balls are a favourite pick at yong tau foo counters and a filling addition to curry mee, laksa and steamboat sets. They can be served whole, halved to show the inside, or simmered in gravy so the fried skin soaks up flavour. For a smaller, bite-size alternative, see TL Bebola Goreng Kecil.

Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack and heat through before serving. Hawkers, restaurants and caterers can contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email for regular supply. They also work well in kuey teow soup, mee hoon soup and economy rice vegetable dishes. Simmer gently until heated through and floating – avoid a hard boil, which can toughen the texture.

TL Fish Paste 400g comes in a green pack labelled Fresh Fish Paste / Kuih Ikan Mentah. Like the rest of the fish paste range, it is raw, ready-mixed paste that saves you the work of preparing fish from scratch, in a 400g size that sits between the 300g home pack and the 1kg bulk bag.

The extra quantity is useful for larger households or a cooking session where you want to make several things at once – a tray of yong tau foo, a batch of hand-rolled fish balls for the freezer, and a few patties for tomorrow’s lunch. Fish paste can also be spread on bread and fried, mixed with chopped vegetables for fritters, or stirred into porridge as soft dumplings.

This is a raw product; cook thoroughly before eating. Contains fish – please check the pack for full ingredient and allergen information. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and thaw in the fridge if frozen. Supplied by Tung Lam Food Industries of Menglembu, Perak.
description.ms:
TL Fish Paste 400g didatangkan dalam bungkusan hijau berlabel Fresh Fish Paste / Kuih Ikan Mentah. Seperti rangkaian isi ikan yang lain, ia ialah isi ikan mentah siap diadun yang menjimatkan kerja menyediakan ikan dari awal, dalam saiz 400g – antara pek rumah 300g dan pek pukal 1kg.

Kuantiti tambahan ini berguna untuk keluarga besar atau sesi memasak apabila anda mahu membuat beberapa hidangan serentak – sedulang yong tau foo, sekumpulan bebola ikan untuk disimpan beku, dan beberapa keping kek ikan untuk makan tengah hari esok. Isi ikan juga boleh disapu pada roti lalu digoreng, digaul dengan sayur cincang untuk cucur, atau dimasukkan ke dalam bubur sebagai ladu lembut.

Ini produk mentah; masak sepenuhnya sebelum dimakan. Mengandungi ikan – sila semak bungkusan untuk butiran ramuan dan alergen. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan, dan cairkan di dalam peti sejuk jika beku. Dibekalkan oleh Tung Lam Food Industries, Menglembu, Perak.

description.en:
Warisan Cendol is Tung Lam’s cendol, sold under the Warisan name with the tagline Warisan Turun Temurun – a heritage handed down through generations. The bag holds ready-made green cendol strands, the soft, slippery jelly at the heart of one of Malaysia’s best-loved desserts.

With cendol already made, ais cendol at home becomes a ten-minute job. Spoon some cendol into a bowl, add shaved or crushed ice, pour over coconut milk and finish with plenty of gula melaka syrup. Add red beans, sweet corn or glutinous rice for a richer bowl, or a scoop of durian for cendol durian. The 500g bag is a family size, good for several bowls on a hot weekend.

Rinse lightly and drain before use if the strands have clumped together. Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack. Produced by Tung Lam Food Industries in Menglembu, Perak – a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.
description.ms:
Warisan Cendol ialah cendol keluaran Tung Lam yang dijual di bawah nama Warisan dengan cogan kata Warisan Turun Temurun. Pek ini berisi cendol hijau yang siap dibuat – jeli lembut dan licin yang menjadi nadi salah satu pencuci mulut paling digemari di Malaysia.

Dengan cendol yang sudah siap, ais cendol di rumah boleh disediakan dalam sepuluh minit. Masukkan cendol ke dalam mangkuk, tambah ais serut atau ais hancur, tuang santan dan siram dengan banyak sirap gula melaka. Tambah kacang merah, jagung manis atau pulut untuk semangkuk yang lebih lazat, atau seulas durian untuk cendol durian. Pek 500g ialah saiz keluarga, cukup untuk beberapa mangkuk pada hujung minggu yang panas.

Bilas sedikit dan toskan sebelum digunakan jika cendol melekat antara satu sama lain. Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan. Dikeluarkan oleh Tung Lam Food Industries di Menglembu, Perak – pengeluar bertauliah Halal, HACCP, GMP dan MeSTI.
description.zh:
Warisan 煎蕊是东临以 Warisan 名称出售的煎蕊，包装标语为 Warisan Turun Temurun，意即「代代相传」。袋内是现成的绿色煎蕊条，柔软滑溜，是大马最受喜爱的甜品之一的灵魂。

煎蕊已经做好，在家做煎蕊冰只需十分钟：把煎蕊放进碗里，加刨冰或碎冰，淋上椰浆，再浇上大量椰糖浆即可。加红豆、玉米粒或糯米会更丰富，加一勺榴梿就是榴梿煎蕊。500克是家庭份量，炎热的周末够做好几碗。

若煎蕊条黏在一起，使用前可稍微冲洗并沥干。请按包装标示冷藏或冷冻保存。由霹雳州万里望的东临食品工业生产，公司持有清真、HACCP、GMP 及 MeSTI 认证。

description.en:
Warisan Cendol 1.5kg is the larger bag of Tung Lam’s Warisan cendol, the ready-made green strands sold under the tagline Warisan Turun Temurun. It holds three times as much as the 500g bag, for kitchens that serve cendol in volume.

Cendol and ABC stalls, kopitiams, cafés, dessert shops and caterers can use it to keep up with demand on hot days without making cendol from scratch. It is equally handy for Hari Raya and Chinese New Year open houses, weddings and school events, where a self-serve cendol station is always popular. Set out the cendol with shaved ice, santan, gula melaka syrup, red beans and sweet corn and let guests build their own bowls.

Keep chilled or frozen as indicated on the pack, and keep opened bags well sealed. For regular trade supply, contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email. Made in Menglembu, Perak by Tung Lam Food Industries, a Halal-certified manufacturer with HACCP, GMP and MeSTI certifications.

Ia juga sangat berguna untuk rumah terbuka Hari Raya dan Tahun Baharu Cina, majlis perkahwinan dan acara sekolah, di mana stesen cendol layan diri sentiasa popular. Sediakan cendol bersama ais serut, santan, sirap gula melaka, kacang merah dan jagung manis, dan biarkan tetamu menyediakan mangkuk sendiri.

Simpan sejuk atau beku seperti yang dinyatakan pada bungkusan, dan tutup rapat pek yang telah dibuka. Untuk bekalan perniagaan tetap, hubungi pasukan jualan kami melalui WhatsApp atau e-mel.
